notes: One release number for the whole repo (CHANGELOG). Components keep their own versions; the Android release tag is android-v<android_app>-b<build>. The strategy hash (StrategyInfo.HASH / Pine STRATEGY_HASH) identifies the exact rule set. research_contracts is the schema generation of contracts/research/ (research.*/1); the research plane is research-only and never changes the strategy, the signal schema or the phone wire format.
